meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

copy.tagline: 构建高质量前端界面与组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成美观、可投产的前端代码
copy.tagline_en: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate beautiful, production-ready frontend code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先定下一个鲜明的视觉方向,再写出可直接运行的网页代码;它会在字体、配色、动效和布局上下功夫,避免千篇一律的 AI 风格。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 制作网页组件、页面或应用等前端界面时,这个技能就会接管。

say.text: 帮我做一个复古未来风格的落地页,要能直接用。
say.note: 会产出该风格的完整可运行页面。

say.text: 做一个极简的 React 组件,配色克制,动效细腻。
say.note: 会得到经过细致打磨的组件代码。

say.text: 设计一个杂志风格的博客首页,用独特字体和不对称布局。
say.note: 会得到有鲜明编辑风格的页面。

howto.what_en: Claude will first commit to a bold visual direction, then write working frontend code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue, etc.) with careful attention to typography, color, motion, layout, and backgrounds, avoiding generic AI aesthetics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build web components, pages, applications, or other frontend interfaces.

say_en.text: Build a retro-futuristic landing page I can use directly.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a working page in that aesthetic.

say_en.text: Create a minimal React component with restrained colors and subtle motion.
say_en.note: Claude will implement a refined React component.

say_en.text: Design a magazine-style blog homepage with distinctive fonts and asymmetric layout.
say_en.note: Claude will craft a bold editorial layout.
